text:
jordan.devex: quick heads-up — i'm about to merge a change that normalizes route hints into a single header across py/ts/go SDKs. it moves from `x-route` -> `x-redwood-route` and packs priority/cost tags (e.g. `x-redwood-route: priority=latency;cost=optimized`).
priya.platform: ugg, that header rename will break our console quota attribution unless we map the old key. do we have a shim? :thinking_face:
eli.eng: there is a small shim planned for the TS/Go SDKs to emit both headers for one release cycle. python needs similar. i can add it but we should be explicit about the opt-out flag.
marta.console: console currently reads `x-route` for the quota tile and routing breakdown. if the header name changes we lose historical continuity for customers on dedicated. mapping is trivial but we need a migration plan for cached dashboards and the per-route cost view.
ops-bot: deploy queued by @jordan.devex for canary in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-21T09:30Z (sha: aa12b7).
jordan.devex: plan: 1) add dual-header shim in all SDKs for 2 minor releases; 2) console will accept both headers and normalize; 3) emit telemetry event `route.header.migration` so we can see who sent only the old key. ok?
priya.platform: agree. also we should ensure quota-ledgers keep key aliasing — otherwise reserved capacity customers might see double-counting across route buckets. need a unit test in quota service.
eli.eng: adding shim now. i'll include env var `REDWOOD_ROUTE_LEGACY=1` that toggles emitting the old header, default enabled for first semver bump. will post link to PR.
marta.console: i'll add normalization in console and a migration job that rewrites cached aggregates for the last 30 days. will file an infra ticket for the db update window.
jordan.devex: rollouts UX: make console show a small banner "route header migration in progress" with a link to migration docs and opt-out flags. keeps customers informed.
priya.platform: who owns the docs? devex + docs. jordan can you author a short migration note + a changelog blurb for the SDKs?
jordan.devex: yep, i'll draft. target: publish note with the canary release.
eli.eng: PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/sdk-headers/pull/488 (draft). tests included.
marta.console: created console ticket: CON-6722, assigned to me, ETA next Wed for normalization and banner.
ops-bot: deploy success (canary eu-west-1) — 3790012345.
jordan.devex: follow-ups: eli — please include telemetry `route.header.present=old|new|both` and `route.priority.v` so we can run a split analysis. priya — confirm quota ledger de-dupe logic. marta — confirm migration job won't exceed maintenance window.
priya.platform: will run ledger dry-run on staging and post results here.
eli.eng: done, added telemetry flags in PR. i'll flip legacy env after one minor release and then remove shim in next major.
jordan.devex: great. thanks all, closing thread once PRs are green. :thumbsup:
